changes: Adds SYSTEM > FORMAT SAMPLES with explicit erase confirmation for first-time sample-storage setup.
Formatting checks card geometry, open files and filesystem status before writing; no automatic format occurs at boot.
Formatting leaves sample storage unavailable until restart, then the existing startup mount enables it.
Retains R012 sample Machines, browsing, Recorder, USB audio and two-official-OS build; DSP remains byte-identical to R012.

hardware_confirmed: Opening FORMAT SAMPLES and cancelling with NO preserved stock audio and sample playback.
Owner confirmed SAMPLES FORMATTED; after a cold restart the sample root was empty and capacity reported 21,474,967,552 bytes free of 21,479,030,784 bytes total.
Elektron Transfer displayed 100% free / 20 GB after formatting and restart.
Two post-format sample uploads were verified by device readback.
offline_checked: Native ColdFire tests covered blank and corrupt media, cancellation without writes, geometry and open-file rejection, explicit formatting, verification failure and preservation before confirmation.

Native first-transfer regression formatted blank sector-backed media, cold-mounted it, queried nonzero capacity, uploaded a sample through native RPC handlers and verified persistence after another cold mount.

Fresh complete public-source build from only the pinned official DN2 OS 1.11 and DT2 OS 1.16 files passed all 115 MAIN stage identities, Recorder/USB continuation checks and exact R013 MAIN, expanded MAIN, runtime, DSP and SysEx identities.
Eight focused source tests passed, including two-input validation for R012/R013, rejection of private sample banks for both, and historical hash-profile preservation.

Browser backend reconstructed and packaged the two official OS inputs into the exact 2,565,664-byte R013 SysEx with SHA-256 06466301ed3642ee104a15cb603609294ab9433a0ac4b4d50c8bb5837e5a8e01; DSP recipe operations remain unchanged from R012.
pending: Complete sample-library restoration and broader R013 endurance testing
validation.notes: Candidate with hardware-verified explicit sample-storage setup and independently matching native-source and browser builds; not yet designated stable.

source_reproduction.notes: Complete fresh public-source build using the two pinned official OS files and existing pinned toolchain. Silent compatibility bank generated from source. No historical firmware build or recorded sample asset was used as a build input.

known_issues: Bulk sample uploads and restoration can interrupt playback. Stop playback during transfers and wait until they finish; report problems that persist afterward.
